results.title: Quantum computing overview
results.content: Quantum computers use quantum bits to represent and process information. This fixture is intentionally small and deterministic for offline pipeline checks.

results.title: Quantum algorithms and applications
results.content: Quantum algorithms use phenomena such as superposition and interference to solve selected problems. Practical applications remain an active research area.

results.title: Preparing for fault-tolerant quantum systems
results.content: Error correction, hardware quality, and scalable control are important milestones on the path toward fault-tolerant quantum computing.

results.title: Quantum computing hardware
results.content: Quantum hardware research compares superconducting, trapped-ion, photonic, and neutral-atom approaches. Each platform balances scale, coherence, control, and manufacturing complexity.

results.title: Quantum software ecosystems
results.content: Quantum software combines circuit design, classical orchestration, simulators, and hardware-aware compilation. Open tooling helps researchers compare algorithms across different devices.

results.title: Quantum security planning
results.content: Organizations are planning migration to post-quantum cryptography while tracking the future impact of quantum algorithms on public-key encryption and long-lived data.
